sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANINDER S. BHATTI  ON THE 10th OF MARCH, 2025
MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 49942 of 2024
DHARMENDRA SINGH CHOUHAN @ BHOLE  Versus
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
Shri Manish Datt - Senior Advocate with Shri Siddharth Bend
Advocate for applicant.
Shri C.K. Mishra - Govt. Advocate for respondent-State.

ORDER This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.702/2023 dated 25.08.2023 registered at Police Station Jamodi District Sidhi for the offence punishable under Sections 302, 449, 376-D, 201 of IPC, Section 51 and 6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 22.08.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.32961/2024.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the present NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12055 2 MCRC-49942-2024 applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail inasmuch as, the present applicant is not the person who has committed the offence on the contrary, the offence was committed by co-accused Mahesh.
It is contended by the counsel that in the present case, the testimony of PW-1 who is sister-in-law of the victim has been recorded, she has not implicated the present applicant.
It is further contended by the counsel that the statement of another witness PW-3 has also been recorded and she has turned hostile.
Simultaneously, the statement of the father of the deceased reflects that the allegations were levelled against one Mahesh and unfortunately, the present applicant has been made a scapegoat.

Hence, it is contended by the Dharmendra Singh Chouhan @ Bhole vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11151952/
1 counsel that in view of the testimonies of the aforesaid witnesses which have been brought on record as Annexure-A-3 to the application, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the prayer and submitted that the present applicant is the person who has committed the offence.
The DNA of the present applicant was found positive in the present case.
It is contended by the counsel that this aspect was already taken note of by this Court while dealing with the application filed by co-accused Dheeraj Singh Chouhan @ Lalji.

It is contended by the counsel that the DNA of the deceased was matched with the present applicant and the Court proceeded to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12055 3 MCRC-49942-2024 grant bail to the co-accused Dheeraj Singh Chouhan @ Lalji.
However as the DNA is positive in respect of the present applicant, therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out to the applicant.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.

A perusal of case diary reflects that the DNA of the present applicant has been found to be positive and considering the nature of allegations levelled against the applicant, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
So far as involvement of another person Mahesh is concerned, it is for the trial Court to take note of the same at appropriate stage under the appropriate provisions.
6. Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the present applicant.
7. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands dismissed.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE mn Dharmendra Singh Chouhan @ Bhole vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11151952/
